prompt: A long telephoto view from far down the hill, looking back up towards the bunker in the first image: perspective flattened so everything stacks up. In the right foreground the smoking burnt-out kill bot from the second image, black and broken, a crow on top, smoke rising straight into the windless grey sky. Up the slope behind it and to the left, the little grey robot from the third image rolling downhill on the open turf, her amber beacon the one warm point, and above her, small at the top left, the overgrown bunker entrance with its plain shut green doors. Muted greens and slate greys. Shot like a 1980s BBC drama on 16mm stock, washed-out colour, gentle contrast, thick grain. Widescreen, no lettering.
